plainTranslation: Mind meets drive. The Mercury person's thinking gets energized and quickened; the Mars person sharpens it into action. Stimulating, decisive, fast. At worst, conversations turn into arguments and words turn into weapons. Failure mode: bickering and cutting remarks. Aim the mental heat at problems, not at each other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep:
Talking to this person can bring your thoughts to the surface before you have had time to organize them. There is something about the exchange between you that invites honesty, immediacy, and response. Conversations may feel alive. They may encourage you to speak more directly, trust your instincts, and engage with what is unfolding in the moment.

This connection pushes both people to be more honest and direct. This person may challenge your thinking, question your assumptions, or encourage you to say what you really mean. The conversations between you are meant to get to the truth.

You enjoy talking to each other. One thought leads to another, and conversations tend to keep moving. There is interest, curiosity, and a sense that both people have something to contribute.

The challenge is learning when to slow the conversation down. Both of you may be quick to respond, quick to react, or quick to move to the next point before fully taking in what was said. At times, this can create unnecessary tension or make a simple difference of opinion feel bigger than it is.

This aspect invites both people to pay attention to how and when things are said.
